name: side_bias
hypothesis: Add a positive bias to side thrust actions (left and right) to encourage more side engine usage, counteracting crosswind and reducing angle at touchdown.

name: lateral_scale_and_side_bias
hypothesis: Scale the x offset and horizontal velocity inputs to increase sensitivity to lateral drift, and add a positive bias to side thrust actions to encourage side engine usage, helping counteract crosswind and improve landing stability.

name: side_bias_0.4
hypothesis: Increasing side thrust bias to 0.4 will further encourage side engine usage under strong crosswind, improving lateral control and landing success.

name: hv_scale_side_bias_scaled
hypothesis: Scale horizontal velocity input to increase sensitivity to lateral drift and amplify side thrust logits while adding a modest side bias, encouraging timely side engine usage under crosswind.

name: left_bias_0.3
hypothesis: Add a positive bias only to the left side thrust action (action 1) to encourage left side engine usage, counteracting the rightward crosswind and improving landing stability.

name: side_bias_0.25
hypothesis: Increase side thrust bias slightly to 0.25 for both side engines, encouraging more side thrust to counteract crosswind without overuse.

name: side_bias_scale_0.2_1.5
hypothesis: Increase side thrust bias to 0.2 and amplify side engine logits by 1.5x to encourage more side engine usage under crosswind, improving lateral control and landing stability.

name: x_hv_scale_side_bias
hypothesis: Increase sensitivity to lateral offset (scale x by 1.3) and slightly damp horizontal velocity (scale hv by 0.9) while adding a modest side thrust bias (0.2) and amplifying side engine logits (1.2x) to improve crosswind handling without overreacting to turbulence.

name: x_hv_scale_side_bias_scaled2
hypothesis: Scale lateral offset and horizontal velocity by 1.5 to increase sensitivity to drift, and amplify side engine logits by 1.2x with a 0.2 bias to encourage timely side thrust under crosswind.

name: angle_reduce_side_bias_scale
hypothesis: Reduce the influence of body angle (scale to 0.5) while boosting side thruster logits (scale 1.4) and dampening main engine logits (scale 0.7). Add a modest side thrust bias (0.15) to encourage timely side engine usage and slower vertical descent, improving stability under strong crosswind.

name: asymmetric_side_bias
hypothesis: Bias the left side engine more (offset 0.3) than the right side engine (offset 0.1) to counteract the rightward crosswind, increase left side engine logit scaling (1.2) while slightly reducing the main engine scaling (0.8) and right side scaling (0.9) to improve lateral control without over‑using thrust.

name: x_scale_side_bias
hypothesis: Scale the lateral offset input by 1.3 to increase sensitivity to crosswind drift, while adding a modest bias (0.2) to both side thruster logits to encourage side engine usage earlier, improving landing stability under crosswind.
